apps/ui/src/components/appearance/Accoun: Account-preference synchronization effect; returns null. Appearance UI and its provider are exercised by their stories; account synchronization belongs to the existing provider integration tests.
apps/ui/src/components/appearance/Appear: Nonvisual context/controller ownership. The real lightweight provider wraps every preview and the Appearance stories exercise its light, dark and System choices.
apps/ui/src/components/elementary/Strapi: CMS preview bootstrap. It only mounts the preview-window message listener and has no standalone visual output.
CMS window-message/reload effect that returns null; mounting it would reload Storybook rather than expose a UI component.
apps/ui/src/components/mobile/live/LiveI: Service-worker installation and navigation bootstrap with no visible UI. Registering the application worker on the Storybook origin would interfere with isolated previews.
apps/ui/src/components/providers/ClientP: Application bootstrap for session-owned query caches, notifications and appearance synchronization. Stories use the individual real contexts with synthetic sessions instead of starting the application runtime.
apps/ui/src/components/providers/GoogleA: Telemetry initialization and routing effects. CookieConsent is catalogued separately; executing the installer would load external telemetry scripts.
apps/ui/src/components/providers/ServerP: Request-owned locale/bootstrap provider with no standalone surface. The preview supplies real NextIntlClientProvider messages and locale.
apps/ui/src/components/providers/Trackin: Application telemetry/script bootstrap. It has no independent UI; third-party scripts must not execute in the isolated catalogue.
Third-party script installer; no visual output. Its script execution is outside a component-library preview.
apps/ui/src/components/seo/JsonLd.tsx#Js: Escaped application/ld+json metadata script only. It has no visual UI; serialization is covered by the existing dedicated tests.
apps/ui/src/components/widgets/WidgetAut: Embed resize/postMessage effect only; returns null. Its cross-origin parent protocol is an integration concern rather than a visual story.
